ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at <5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid black pigmentation across both lobes with discrete, high-contrast white punctate spots distributed across the surface. Distinct high-intensity pixel clustering is observed at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a pixel-calculated acute angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. A significant high-amplitude indentation (notch) is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric profile exhibits a convex sweep from the median notch transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels resembling barnacle attachment scars, concentrated heavily on the right distal tip and scattered across the central fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, particularly on the right lobe, oriented diagonally and horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation or 'chunk' missing from the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy white scarring and possible parasitic remnants on both distal tips.
